en.headline: High-speed trains to Zhanjiang add stop at Taishan from today
en.dek: MTR said daily services between West Kowloon and Zhanjiang West now call at Taishan, bringing the number of direct stations to 114.
body: The MTR Corporation said that from today, daily high-speed rail services between Hong Kong West Kowloon station and Zhanjiang West station will add a stop at Taishan.
The affected trains are G6048/5 and G6046/7. The change increases the number of stations with direct high-speed rail links to Hong Kong to 114.

MTR said the new stop would make it more convenient for residents and visitors to return home for family visits or for travel. Taishan is known as a major hometown of overseas Chinese in the Greater Bay Area.
Journey times between West Kowloon and Taishan are about two hours and ten minutes in either direction.

zh.headline: 高鐵西九龍至湛江西車次今起加停台山站
zh.dek: 港鐵表示，每日來往西九龍及湛江西的列車加停台山，直達站點增至114個，方便市民回鄉探親。
body: 港鐵公司表示，由今日起，每日來往香港西九龍站及湛江西站的高鐵車次會加停台山站。
相關車次為G6048/5及G6046/7。是次調整令高鐵直達站點增至114個。
港鐵稱，新站點方便市民及旅客回鄉探親或旅遊。台山是大灣區著名僑鄉。
西九龍與台山之間單程約需兩小時十分鐘。
